title: Mark Nelson
description: Recalls Mark Nelson: "I remember seeing STAR WARS when it was first released in the theaters, being mesmerized through the film, and as the final credits rolled, thinking: this film has action, adventure, heroes, villains, story; it's creative, direct and honest. I want more! Luckily, STAR WARS was just the first taste of what was to come." Beginning his career in the early '80s, Nelson's works include ALIENS, NIGHTBREED, HELLRAISER and many others.
